title: Test Doubles & Contract Testing
intro: Test doubles in RSpec — doubles, instance_doubles, class_doubles, and spies — are the mechanism for isolating units from their dependencies. The critical rule is to use verifying doubles (instance_double, class_double) rather than plain doubles, because verifying doubles fail if the stubbed method doesn't exist on the real class. This prevents tests from passing while production code breaks due to a method rename. WebMock stubs HTTP requests at the Net::HTTP level; VCR records and replays real HTTP interactions as cassettes. Contract testing with Pact verifies that a Rails API continues to honour the contract its consumers depend on — a safety net for microservices. This page covers all three layers with the practical gotchas that appear in senior interviews.
